raw_segments.text: Or, again, note the meanderings of some purling rill as it babbles on its way, though quarreling
with the stony obstacles, to the tumbling waters of Neptune's blue domain, mid-mossy
banks, fanned by gentlest zephyrs, played on by the glorious sunlight, or neath the
shadows cast o'er its pensive bosom by the overarching leafage of the giants of the forest.
He asked over the fringe of his newspaper.
